posts.post: people who wear pajamas to the coffee shop: are you feeling peaceful or did you lose the will to participate in society today?
nothing reveals a person’s true priorities faster than whether they hang their clothes or leave them on a chair.
the ‘i’ll wear this when i lose weight’ box is just a graveyard for perfectly good outfits.
owning more than five pairs of jeans but wearing the same one every week is a lifestyle.
